content:
I have formalized a recent preprint by myself, Joao Pedro Marciano and Victor Souza (with lots of help from various LLMs), and wondered if there is a formalization or project to formalize Freiman's theorem (covering a set with small sumset by a smallish GAP with low dimension). I am aware of the PFR project, but I couldn't figure out a way to deduce Freiman's theorem from those results.

Concretely, I would actually need a version of the Green--Ruzsa theorem and Chang's theorem (to bound the dimension of the GAP by the Freiman dimension of the underlying set), but having a proof of Freiman's theorem would probably be generalizable to that case (at least the proof that I am aware of).

could you help me? otherwise, i would probably start spending my tokens on doing just that

Also, any feedback on the formalization (or the preprint) would be appreciated :)

Hey Gabriel. Chang's lemma (for finite abelian groups) is available in YaelDillies/apap. I am currently working on proving a much more general version (arbitrary group, restricted to a specific kind of functions), but this should be irrelevant to you at this time.
Also your preprint is on my toread list :wink:
